name: HIST 3568
title: Hip Hop, Politics and Youth Culture in America
description: (Also offered as AFRA 3568, AMST 3568, MUSI 3568.) History of hip-hop, its musical antecedents and its role in popular culture. Race, class, and gender are examined as well as hip-hop's role in popular political discourse.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
